context: A police officer briefs a uni reporter about department rotations
purpose: Teach: 学歴/管轄/債券/互換/受験生/行え/工法/断定

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 人事配置、学歴のみで決めることはありません。
lines.en: Personnel placements aren't decided by credentials alone.
lines.style: Measured, professional opening. Steady eye-level. No defensiveness—just clarity. Breath is even. Speaking from experience, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 管轄の引き継ぎ、互換性のある人選を意識されますか。
lines.en: When you hand off jurisdiction, do you consciously pick people who can adapt to it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly uncertain lean forward. Testing whether this question will land. Quiet but engaged. Genuine curiosity underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。受験生のように、若手も体系的に学んでいます。
lines.en: Yes. Young officers study systematically, just like exam candidates do.
lines.style: Affirmative nod in the voice. Clear, almost methodical pacing. The weight of institutional knowledge behind it. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 断定的な現場判断、その後の自信につながりますね。
lines.en: So making decisive calls in the field builds that confidence later on.
lines.style: Gentle realization in the tone, not a question despite the upward turn. Ren is piecing something together aloud. Warm, reflective. Seeking confirmation more than asking.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。最先端の捜査工法も、行えるよう研修を続けます。
lines.en: Yes. We maintain continuous training so officers can handle the latest investigative methods.
lines.style: Direct continuation of thought. Warm but formal—the language of institutional commitment. Breath controlled. Building on what came before, not restarting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 債券詐欺などの専門部署も、その流れですか。
lines.en: Specialist units like financial crimes—they follow that same framework?
lines.style: Following the thread carefully. Slight rise at the end—genuine question, not rhetorical. Ren is connecting dots aloud. Respectful of the answer coming.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.style: Quiet confirmation. A small smile in the voice. The conversation has moved from explanation to mutual understanding. One word, fully present.
